scope: Read-only audit of vendor Linux 4.19 MM pressure instrumentation after the 5.15 PSI scheduler/cgroup/trigger backport. This report does not modify firmware or source.

decision.selected: Do not add standalone swap_readpage instrumentation commit 937790699be9 in this version.
decision.reason: The isolated hook has known cold-swapin over-accounting on zram/zswap. Its correctness fix depends on PageWorkingset, which the current tree does not implement. Avoid adding a known semantic error merely to broaden hook coverage.
decision.current_version_scope: Complete cgroup hierarchy pressure interfaces, trigger/poll lifetime and delivery, CPU quota/competition accounting, and validated existing reclaim/compaction memory accounting.
decision.explicit_limitation: The scheduler PSI implementation is newer than the surrounding 4.19 MM instrumentation. Do not claim complete modern memory PSI/refault/swap coverage.
decision.follow_up: Backport a coherent working-set/refault/swap series with all prerequisites and correctness fixes, then re-run ABI, QEMU pressure, cold/hot page-cache and swap backend comparisons.

state_storage_compatibility.verified: No MM/block source directly accesses old PF_MEMSTALL or new in_memstall; instrumentation uses the stable enter/leave API. All currently present MM enter/leave pairs were reviewed for normal/error-path pairing.
state_storage_compatibility.nested_sections: Caller-local unsigned long pflags stores the previous state through the API; changing PSI internal storage does not require changing existing MM callers.

memory_high.coverage: Actual synchronous memory.high reclaim interval is measured, including sleeps and reclaim CPU time. The task/group performing the stall is the PSI owner. Small bookkeeping outside the reclaim call is not characterized as memory stall.
memory_high.modern_penalty_sleep: Absent in this 4.19 implementation; do not misdescribe absence of the later 5.15 penalty-sleep hook as a lost current code path.
memory_high.interrupt_path: Charges made in interrupt context schedule high_work instead of penalizing a random interrupted task. Resulting reclaim pressure belongs to the worker/system, not directly to the target memory-charge cgroup. This follows task-stall semantics.
memory_high.verdict: No mandatory MM-source change was identified solely to keep current memory.high reclaim working with the new PSI state machine.

omissions.observed: Calls io_schedule while waiting but has no working-set-sensitive psi_memstall markers.
omissions.effect: Refault I/O waits contribute to I/O pressure where in_iowait is set, but cannot be fully attributed to memory pressure.
omissions.priority: Required before claiming full refault/thrashing memory PSI; coherent future series, not a state-storage migration defect.

omissions.observed: No psi_memstall annotation around frontswap_load, rw_page, or submission.
omissions.effect: Zswap decompression/zram synchronous loading and swap submission stalls are not explicitly memory pressure. Async completion waits also need filemap-side instrumentation.
omissions.priority: Deferred together with working-set correctness prerequisites; standalone 937790 deliberately rejected.

omissions.observed: Existing TODO says use_memdelay needs psi_memstall_enter/leave. io_schedule_prepare/finish is present.
omissions.effect: A memory-related blkcg throttle delay is represented as I/O pressure but lacks the additional memory-pressure classification.
omissions.priority: A bounded conditional enter/leave enhancement is possible, but not applied by this audit; evaluate reachable policy paths and test separately.

omissions.effect: Cannot safely apply upstream hot/cold page classification by copying a guard or tagging every page.
omissions.priority: Fundamental prerequisite requiring page-flag ABI/bit-layout audit.

omissions.effect: Cannot currently distinguish working-set read submission in generic block paths.
omissions.priority: Requires propagation and bit-number audit; do not shift vendor-visible existing flag values.

upstream_reference.note: Pinned upstream used to compare code paths, not to assert complete 5.15 MM behavior in this 4.19 kernel.

necessary_now: Keep enter/leave API and nesting semantics coherent with the selected PSI state representation.
Preserve fork clearing, scheduler memstall-running accounting and cgroup migration accounting; verified in the inspected candidate.
Exercise memory.high reclaim and pressure thresholds in QEMU; verify pressure totals increase without PSI task-state underflow.
Disclose the MM coverage limits; do not imply that newer psi.c alone modernizes every MM call site.
future_validation: Compare hot refault thrashing with ordinary cold file reads; cold I/O should not be indiscriminately memory pressure.
Compare hot and cold swapins on physical swap, zram and zswap so backend implementation does not produce misleading pressure classification.
Cover sync and async swap read paths, frontswap hits, rw_page hits, swap-file reads, allocation failure and all early returns.
Audit PG_workingset and BIO_WORKINGSET numeric encoding against proprietary module expectations; preserve existing bit values.
Exercise nested reclaim plus swap/refault markers to avoid double-entry state corruption or leaked memstall state.
